item.text: I’ll inspect the package parsing implementation and its existing tests, record the checkpoint, then make the smallest code change that meets the ecosystem rules and run the relevant tests.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p .codex-role-output && cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Task: Resolve package name parsing for Maven, PyPI, Golang, npm, and Cocoapods PURLs.

Initial status: Starting repository inspection. I will use checked-out code and existing tests only.
EOF
pwd && git status --short && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!vendor'"' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!**/.git/**'"' && rg -n \"parsePkgName|parse.*Pkg|PURL|purl\" -g '"'!vendor'"' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!**/.git/**'"' ."
